clustering_basis: Hypothesis-level: ideas grouped by shared falsifiable core claim and mechanism (what would be true of the world if the idea holds), not by keyword or domain. Cross-domain ideas sharing the same claim template are co-clustered; true near-duplicates are merged, retained template twins are recorded as near-duplicate relations.

clusters.name: eval_statistical_validity
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Measurement noise (label error, metric/inference noise, preprocessing variance, statistical power, dataset contamination, rater-noise floor) is comparable to or larger than typical claimed between-method differences, so many published rankings are unresolved.

clusters.name: task_relevant_metric_decoupling
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Model orderings induced by overlap metrics (Dice/IoU) decouple from orderings induced by task-relevant quantities (dose, volume/change detection, topology, failure rate, human preference, physical correlates, deployment false alarms, detection latency), so overlap-based selection regularly picks the wrong model for the actual use case.

clusters.name: evaluation_protocol_artifacts
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Specific bookkeeping and protocol choices (empty-case conventions, tight-box prompt leakage, prompt budgets, evaluation resolution on fractal boundaries, illumination mix, instance conventions, detectability weighting, temporal-consistency preferences) materially change scores and rankings independent of model quality.

clusters.name: peft_comparison_validity
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Published PEFT/adaptation method comparisons are confounded by per-method hyperparameter (LR) mismatch, unmatched compute, memorization-prone splits, and missing floor/ceiling baselines (linear probing, random encoder); correcting the protocol overturns a large fraction of rankings.

clusters.name: detection_vs_delineation
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Aggregate segmentation scores conflate detection/localization with delineation; detection dominates the variance (small structures, lesions, early events), making the field's segmentation-metric conclusions substantially detection claims in disguise.

clusters.name: supervision_definition_gap
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Sites, annotators, protocols, and time periods define systematically different labeling functions; a large share of cross-dataset/cross-site performance gap is a supervision-definition gap (convention/style), which is learnable, transferable, and correctable as a readout policy rather than a perception failure.

clusters.name: model_as_disagreement_simulator
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Cheap model-derived output distributions (multimask spread, per-rater-trained nets, seed ensembles, K-hypothesis heads, generative mask distributions) reproduce human inter-annotator disagreement structure well enough to substitute for multi-rater panels.

clusters.name: continuous_latent_thresholding
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Binary masks are threshold quantizations of a continuous latent field (density/transmittance/membership); the continuous variable is present in features and in disagreement statistics, is lost at the binarizing head/target, and recovering it fixes bias, calibration, and cross-protocol transfer.

clusters.name: annotation_protocol_design
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Annotation budget and protocol design (mode per geometry, slice fraction, halo/uncertain regions, per-annotator vs consensus labels, explicit negative evidence, media-specific ontology, noise-model realism, pilot rater studies) is a solvable optimization with measurable model consequences.

clusters.name: annotation_process_imprint
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: The annotation/generation process (tools, interpolation, QC smoothing, registration propagation, out-of-plane tracing, capture settings, convention parameters like shadows) leaves identifiable morphological signatures in labels that models internalize and reproduce.

clusters.name: adaptation_data_efficiency
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: What adaptation needs from labeled data is low-bandwidth (shift directions, conventions, prompt-response coverage), so selection by feature coverage, hardness, disagreement, prompt diversity, or cheap human-in-the-loop harvesting beats matched random labeling, and label noise is filtered by low-rank capacity.

clusters.name: self_training_prior_reinforcement
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Confidence-filtered self-training/pseudo-labeling reinforces the base model's priors and contracts the prediction distribution, systematically failing on exactly the patterns that define the domain gap or rare variants.

clusters.name: peft_update_geometry
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: The converged PEFT update has interpretable low-dimensional structure (layer/projection energy signatures, stable rank, subspace overlap with init, orthogonality across domains, spectral properties) that predicts required rank, seed variance, soup/merge behavior, and optimization stability.

clusters.name: minimal_sufficient_adaptation
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: For low-level (photometric/sensor/statistics) shifts, tiny targeted interventions (input LUT/conv, tone curves, LayerNorm scales, channel gates, PE-only tuning, first-layer renormalization, physics-simulated noise training, alternative input representations) recover most of full PEFT's gain and localize what the shift physically is.

clusters.name: geometric_scale_prior_mismatch
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Foundation and medical models carry scale/orientation/relative-size priors from training statistics; performance failures on atypical scales (thin structures vs patch size, huge objects, pediatric anatomy, pathology zoom, non-canonical orientation) are geometric-prior failures fixable by input renormalization rather than appearance learning.

clusters.name: capability_erosion
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Fine-tuning erases specific, separable capabilities (multimask/granularity diversity, self-calibration, corrective-click integration, boundary precision, near-domain skills) in predictable patterns, and shallow interventions (rehearsal, head-only retraining) recover much of the loss.

clusters.name: edge_affinity_prior
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Pretrained segmenters carry a strong prior that boundaries live on high-gradient image edges; their errors displace systematically toward strong irrelevant edges (contrast gaps, smoke boundaries, medical definitional boundaries), distinguishable from scratch-trained error structure.

clusters.name: sam_perceptual_mechanisms
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: SAM's grouping is governed by identifiable low-level mechanisms (photometric contiguity, contrast polarity, high-frequency edge reliance, convention mixtures for transparency, encoder-level segmentability, prompt-starved camouflage) that predict its failures independent of semantic domain.

clusters.name: gap_localization_readout
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: For many target domains the frozen encoder already contains the needed information; the dominant gap is at the readout (decoder, prompt space, granularity/hierarchy selection, head resolution), which layer-resolved divergence and probing can localize a priori.

clusters.name: prompt_interface_mechanics
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Prompt geometry and harvesting mechanics (click-boundary distance, box scale information, sub-patch aliasing, negative-prompt edge following, grid sampling and NMS) mechanistically determine large classes of SAM behavior commonly misattributed to perception.

clusters.name: pretraining_provenance_priors
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: SA-1B's construction (content frequency, curation style, mask-count statistics, granularity frequencies, privacy blurring, bootstrap conventions) installed measurable priors that propagate to all derived models and largely predict zero-shot gaps.

clusters.name: synthetic_and_physical_data
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Physical correctness of training data (calibrated compositing, metered fog alpha, sensor-noise matching, chemistry diversity, scattering-parameter similarity) dominates visual realism and raw scale for transfer, and its absence creates artifact-keying and spoofing vulnerabilities.

clusters.name: shortcut_priors_medical
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Medical segmentation models rely on contextual/statistical shortcuts (location priors, anchor organs, scanner fingerprints, absolute intensities, dataset identity, batch statistics, report-language binding, healthy-anatomy completion) rather than target evidence, producing confident well-formed errors and no plausibility signal.

clusters.name: output_pipeline_bottleneck
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: A large share of end-task error is introduced after the model's decision, in low-res mask representations, fixed upsampling, iso-surfacing/smoothing, or the segmentation intermediate itself; oracle-injection experiments can bound this and sometimes justify bypassing segmentation entirely.

clusters.name: topology_thin_structures
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Topological correctness of thin structures is input-noise-chaotic and prior-sensitive: stabilization beats topology-penalized training, continuity priors anti-inform occlusive disease, and shape-prior strength acts as a hidden fairness parameter over rare anatomy.

clusters.name: uncertainty_calibration_safety
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Learned confidence heads and sampling-based uncertainty are largely reducible to simple geometry (boundary distance, jitter variance) and fail optimistically under shift; perturbation-based signals, recalibration-only pathways, conformal scalars, and two-axis (spread vs jitter) readouts are more robust and cheaper, with equity consequences for abstention.

clusters.name: label_free_auditing
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Model-internal signals (runner-up-correct signatures, ensemble disagreement, anatomical-invariant violations) localize label errors, convention offsets, and quality rank without ground truth, enabling label auditing and unsupervised evaluation.

clusters.name: lifecycle_deployment_ops
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Adapter lifecycle operations (transport across base models, sequential ordering, routing with novelty fallback, foundation-vs-specialist total-cost decisions) have predictable rules derivable from feature-space structure.

clusters.name: training_dynamics_boundary_memorization
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Fitting is spatially and temporally staged: interiors/regions generalize early, ambiguous boundary bands are memorized late; schedules, curricula, gradient surgery, label smoothing, and deliberate boundary jitter exploit this to preserve calibration and robustness at lower cost.

clusters.name: media_temporal_dynamics
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: For amorphous media the discriminative information is concentrated in temporal dynamics (turbulence spectra, decorrelation half-lives, divergence fields, gravity-signed motion, flicker, motion salience), which single-frame models cannot access and which sensor pipelines reshape; temporal statistics enable small models to match large single-frame ones.

clusters.name: multimodal_sensing_media
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Modality physics (polarization, thermal-visible disagreement, dual-band attenuation ratios, depth-failure signatures, flash differentials, rolling-shutter row spectra, audio) supply cheap near-orthogonal signals for glass/smoke/fire that visible-appearance models fundamentally lack.

clusters.name: image_formation_physics_media
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Single-image formation physics (transmittance identifiability, detectability indices, chromatic consistency, background-continuation residuals, displacement fields, shadow channels, illuminated-vs-emitting distinction, smoke-haze transfer-function coincidence) defines both hard information limits and unexploited channels for media perception.

clusters.name: media_representation_output_space
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Choosing physics- or structure-aligned output spaces (log-transmittance additivity, nested level sets, layer counting, reflection/transmission decomposition, presence-vs-evidence dual masks, amodal objectives with predictable dissociations, matting pretraining, motion-derived 3D) changes what generalizes, beyond architecture or data scale.

clusters.name: interactive_refinement_dynamics
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Interactive segmentation dynamics are a distinct object of study: refinement oscillates non-convergently on ambiguous content, click economics scale with geometry (slices vs shape), and realistic click policies rather than random simulation determine deployed efficiency.

clusters.name: human_ai_workflow
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Human-AI contouring workflows have their own failure physics: automation bias, distribution collapse toward model modes, non-monotone final quality in model accuracy, plausibility-gated (not magnitude-gated) error detection, anchoring by uncertainty overlays, and edit logs as the truer quality signal.

clusters.name: media_context_shortcuts
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Media segmenters rely on scene context, color subspaces, rims, category identity, viewpoint-conditioned speculars, and camera artifacts (bloom, bitrate, resolution) rather than material evidence; counterfactual manipulations quantify each reliance and predict field false positives/misses.

clusters.name: frozen_foundation_signals
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Frozen foundation-model behaviors on media are exploitable sensors: prompt fall-through rate is an opacity meter, and cross-model inconsistency signatures localize transparent surfaces with zero task-specific training.

clusters.name: consistency_as_supervision
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Internal consistency violations (across jittered prompts, flips, multimask candidates, adjacent CT slices) are enriched at error locations and supply label-free adaptation signal competitive with small supervised sets.

clusters.name: distribution_shift_medical
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: Cross-site gaps decompose into case-mix, contrast phase, habitus geometry, and acquisition-parameter envelopes with identifiable structure; harmonization/TTA that normalizes shift also normalizes away pathology signal, inverting clinical priorities.

clusters.name: volumetric_geometry_inference
clusters.cluster_hypothesis: 3D inference plumbing (resampling, patchwise objectives, window grids, padding side channels, axial anisotropy, FOV truncation, SR priors, 2D/3D disagreement bands) creates systematic, fixable error classes independent of representation quality.

high_value_anomalies.why: Defect-as-sensor inversion: prompt fall-through rate as a calibrated opacity meter. Cheap, odd, and opens a supervision channel for media models.
Cheap oracle experiment (feed ground-truth low-res masks through SAM's own output path) that could bound and deflate a large fraction of the boundary-fine-tuning literature.
Non-monotone final-contour quality as model accuracy rises (rare errors evade review). Safety-critical, testable, and contradicts the field's implicit monotonicity assumption.
Bypass segmentation entirely for scalar clinical endpoints. If direct regression degrades more gracefully under shift, large parts of pipeline design are misallocated effort.
Random-encoder floor for adaptation benchmarks: exposes which benchmarks actually test foundation knowledge. High leverage as a field-wide audit at low compute.
Adapter transport across base models via a linear feature-space map. If even partially true, changes the economics of adapter ecosystems on evolving bases.
Active micro-motion + rigidity-violation test for refractive surfaces: converts a passive perception problem into an active sensing one at tiny model cost.
Rolling-shutter row-spectrum as a single-frame flame-dynamics cue: camera-artifact physics used as signal rather than nuisance.
Synthetic media fully activate deployed smoke/fire pipelines, enabling spoofing/injection; physically grounded consistency checks as the countermeasure. Security-relevant and immediately testable.
Annotator disagreement probability as a monotone function of transmittance: turns annotation noise into a physical densitometer with zero density supervision.
Abstention correlates with disease burden, so automation is enriched for healthy cases: an equity failure mode invisible to aggregate uncertainty metrics.
SA-1B privacy blurring taught blur-transition edges as objectness evidence: a sharp, falsifiable provenance quirk with dataset-governance implications.
Physical compositing correctness beats visual realism for synthetic-to-real transfer: factorial design cleanly separates two conflated data-quality axes.
Fractional-membership training: identical overlap metrics but unbiased volumetry. Quietly high clinical value hidden from standard evaluation.

caveats: No novelty verification was performed; 'likely-known' and 'prior-art risk' notes are advisory judgments only.
No citations were consulted or invented.
